V4 SURVIVOR-ONLY ELO

ELO is a relative-ranking layer, never a scientific-validity gate.
Only ideas already marked GREENLIGHT by the same-round Phase 10 -> 11 -> 12 -> 13 survival loop may enter.
Compare each survivor pair on:
- Novelty
- Feasibility
- Relevance
- Clarity
Score each 1-10, compute the mean composite, and update Elo ratings (default start 1500, K=32).
A killed, unresolved, or merely revised idea must never enter ELO.
